newsitem.title: UK: Saga says 82,000 bpd Tordis shut due to full stora.
newsitem.headline: Saga says 82,000 bpd Tordis shut due to full stora.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said it had shut its 82,000 barrel per day (bpd) North Sea Tordis oilfield at 1530 GMT on Friday.
The field had been closed because bad weather has prevented tankers loading from the Gullfaks C platform where production from Tordis is sent.
The disruption to loadings has backed up oil at Gullfaks C where storage tanks are now filled to capacity.
"We hope that it will be over by Sunday," said a spokeswoman for the company.
North Sea loadings by shuttle tankers have been severely disrupted recently due to hurricane-force winds and high swell.
